bio: The chef was a DJ in a former life, and the technique he applied in that calling, break beats, informs both the name of the restaurant and the music piped through the dining room. The signature dish is soy-sauce ramen, which owes its beautiful presentation and clear soup to careful preparation of the noodles. The purity of the broth delights the palate from the first mouthful. With rhythmic tempo, you’ll reel in the noodles and drink every drop of soup before you know it. A beat-driven bowl that hit big in Meguro....
